The women's 100 metre butterfly competition at the 2022 Mediterranean Games was held on 4 July 2022 at the Aquatic Center of the Olympic Complex in Bir El Djir.[1]

Records

Prior to this competition, the existing world and Mediterranean Games records were as follows:

World record  Sarah Sjöström (SWE) 55.48 Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 7 August 2016
Mediterranean Games record  Elena Di Liddo (ITA) 57.59 Tarragona, Spain 23 June 2018

The following records were established during the competition:
